display_long_description:
Create your avatar, build almost anything, and hang out with other players.

# Create Your Avatar

Make a character in minutes. Build a person, creature, object, or something totally weird—the tools are simple, fast, and easy to learn.
[media]

# Build, Share, and Explore

Use intuitive 3D creation tools to make avatars, props, accessories, and more. Explore player-made creations, record videos with the in-game camera, and share your best ideas.

# Hang Out With Friends

Blobtown is multiplayer from the start. Meet new people, show off your creations, and spend time in a colorful social world built for creativity and fun.

# Buy and Sell Creations

Use Blobium to buy player-made items, from avatars to accessories. Make something great? Open your own shop and sell it to other players.

# Jump Into Physics Battles

Build custom melee weapons and test them in fast, silly battles where size, weight, and shape matter.

New worlds, items, and features are added regularly as Blobtown keeps growing.
